# Vimbre

Vimbre is a work continuity platform for teams. It plans your day, keeps your decisions and writes your handovers, using AI that drafts and people approve.

- [Product](https://vimbre.com/how-it-works) — How conversations become reviewed tasks, decisions and handovers.
- [Pricing](https://vimbre.com/pricing) — Monthly GBP plans, people limits and AI allowances.
- [FAQ](https://vimbre.com/faq) — Answers about Vimbre, access and reviewed AI.
- [Integrations](https://vimbre.com/integrations) — The eight listed tools and current connection availability.
- [Sign up](https://vimbre.com/signup) — Create an individual, sole founder or company account.
